Providing details about the extracted data, such as sample size and outcome measures, enables readers and other researchers to evaluate the quality and relevance of the included studies. Moreover, the availability of this data is invaluable for future research, providing a solid foundation for new studies. Therefore, it is ideal for authors to detail these data in the manuscript, supplementary material, or an external repository, which enriches the transparency and usefulness of the meta-analysis for the scientific community.
